title: Menu Section

fields.label: Menu Section
fields.name: menu_section
fields.instructions: Which off-canvas (hamburger) menu shows on this page — set to "Business" for pages on the Business side of the site (Merchant Solutions, Enterprise, Payroll Solutions, etc.), matching the header's own Personal/Business toggle. Each menu is managed separately under Appearance → Menus ("Primary Menu (Personal)" / "Business Menu").

description: Controls which of the two off-canvas nav menus (Personal / Business) renders on this page.
